title: 🎤 BitClub Network Marbella - Unai and Dragos
description: BitClub Training in Marbella - Sept. 2018 Interview with Unai Martínez (Basque Country) and Dragos Dumitru (Madrid - Romania) ...

asr.full_text: Good afternoon, how does BitClub Network work and it's benefit? Ok, I'll start. Unai, please. One of the pillars that BICLUB has given me is mainly financial education. I have also suffered a lot because, in current education, people are not being taught financially... and that is a serious problem. So, I am, personally, every when I have to stop, it's educating myself financially, and in other areas, of course. And BICLUB is one of the motorbikes that has helped me to realize where economy has gone, We are going to see a future where it's safe and profitable. I want to help so that others will get the same opportunities like I have. Stupendous! I wanted to be with them because they are always the most powerful people and can provide you with a lot of information. I have been in the world of cryptocurrency for a year and a half and three months ago I opened my eyes to the world of mining. So I have been in this business since June and the truth is that it has provided me a lot and every day I learn a lot and I'd like to contribute to you what I've learned here these days. I'd like to share information with my team. Thank you very much.
